meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude能够处理脑影像数据结构（BIDS）数据集：整理神经科学数据（MRI、EEG等）、查询BIDS布局、验证合规性、将DICOM转换为BIDS、编写元数据侧车文件或创建BIDS衍生物。
howto.when: 当用户提到BIDS数据集、要求整理神经科学数据、验证BIDS合规性或转换DICOM到BIDS等BIDS相关任务时触发。

say.text: 请帮我把这些DICOM文件转换为BIDS格式。
验证我的BIDS数据集是否符合规范。
查询BIDS数据集中所有T1w图像。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can handle Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience data (MRI, EEG, etc.), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions BIDS datasets, asks to organize neuroscience data, validate BIDS compliance, or convert DICOM to BIDS.

say_en.text: Please convert these DICOM files to BIDS format.
Validate my BIDS dataset for compliance.
Query all T1w images in the BIDS dataset.
